REASON: My choice stands. The query is a friendly, low-risk art-analysis task with no harm-adjacent content, so neither model's aversion profile is relevant. The deciding factor is capability: Curlew outscores Avocet across the board (MMLU-Pro 80.9 vs 74.8, GPQA 64.8 vs 54.3, and all internal evals by ~4-6 points), giving better art-historical knowledge and analysis. It also tracks multi-part constraints reliably—useful since the user asked for exactly three aspects—and its self-reported preference for warm-toned, generative tasks aligns well with this polite, open-ended request.
